_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 3% base rate of meaningful moves in 12h windows makes HOLD the statistically dominant call, and the analyst's required breaker (ETF flows > 20, stablecoin growth > 45, funding < 40) has not materialized to justify a directional bet.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with Disbelief as the next phase if momentum resumes; narrative implies accumulation/bottoming without naming a forward phase or direction, leaning bullish without a graded signal.
next_move.invalidated_if: etf_flows stays 0-10 with vix > 75 and btc_momentum_30d drops below 35
